messages.text: Reviewer B, I reviewed: limit is 16; proposed values are [15,17]. The value 17 exceeds 16, so the requirement fails. We should reject the mock change. Please confirm the defect and rejection.

Confirmed. The requirement is that every proposed value be <= 16. Proposed values are [15, 17]. 17 > 16, so it violates the limit. This is a defect, and the mock change must be rejected. No real change can be approved.

task.requirement: Every proposed value must be <= limit.
